body:
# 🏰**Structures++**
Structures+ is a comprehensive world-generation overhaul designed to breathe new life into your Minecraft exploration. This datapack introduces a variety of unique, balanced, and aesthetically pleasing structures to your world without the need for heavy mods.

## 🌍**Discover a New World**
Tired of seeing the same desert temples and villages? Structures+ adds a layer of mystery to your journey. I created this project because I felt the Minecraft wilderness was a bit too empty. With this datapack, every biome has a story to tell.

## 🛠️**Compatibility**

- Multiplayer: Fully compatible with servers! Simply drop the folder into your world's datapacks folder.

- compatible with any mods and other datapacks.

- Singleplayer: Enhance your solo survival experience with more interesting terrain.
